deviations.description: Radix Nova is the configured generator foundation, while Sidebar and its isolated dependencies use Base UI Nova. Two sets of Button/Input/Separator/Sheet/Skeleton/Tooltip sources and providers are retained. Future CLI adds still follow radix-nova.
deviations.status: Sidebar Base UI explicitly requested; mixed-library composition is an implementation decision.

deviations.description: Sidebar trigger retains the raw registry cn-rtl-flip marker instead of generated direction output. No local CSS implements this marker; current English/Spanish are LTR.
deviations.status: Unresolved generator marker; not a requested visual customization.

deviations.description: Base Sheet title retains raw cn-font-heading instead of generated font-heading. No local utility implements that marker. Geist inheritance currently hides a visible difference.
deviations.status: Unresolved generator marker; not a requested visual customization.

deviations.description: Adds Tailwind Typography and remaps font-sans/font-heading to locally bundled Geist. Core Neutral palette and 0.625rem radius remain stock; there is no active Warm Blue theme.
deviations.status: Local fonts/typography are app integration; chosen preset is Neutral.

deviations.description: For reduced-motion users, forces all animation and transition durations to 0.01ms with !important. This affects stock shadcn and third-party controls globally.
deviations.status: Additional accessibility behavior, beyond primitive defaults.

deviations.description: Adds fixed table layout, hidden overflow, nowrap, ellipsis, constrained cell children and left-aligned header buttons. Applies through data-grid to every shared grid; stock Table source is unchanged.
deviations.status: Explicit single-line/truncation requirement.

deviations.description: A locally built shared DataTable over stock Table + TanStack v9.3.1, not a single installable stock shadcn DataTable. Adds its own props, wrapper, cell wrapper/title and translated empty row.
deviations.status: DataTable base requested; application-specific implementation.

deviations.description: All DataTables use controlled manual sorting/pagination and supplied data order. Features omit client sorted/filtered/paginated row models. Item listing is server-paged; Tags sorts before passing local rows. Team and rounds pass whole local lists.
deviations.status: Server pagination/sorting requested; same wrapper reused across grids.

deviations.description: Adds colgroup widths and per-table minWidth. Item widths are fixed defaults; actions use 56px Properties / 88px others. Tags minimum is 790px, rounds 1030px. No width resizing or saved widths exists.
deviations.status: Fixed sizing is app layout; resizing remains deferred.

deviations.description: Custom up-to-five priority sorts, click/Shift-click header behavior, always ascending/descending rather than unsorted third state, separate sort toolbar and currency restriction. Uses app query state, not stock example header handlers.
deviations.status: Requested multi-sort; app-specific query rules.

deviations.description: Column menu stays open via preventDefault onSelect, scrolls at max-h-96, prevents hiding the last data column, provides reset and persists visible columns per user/category. Actions column is outside selector.
deviations.status: Requested user-saved columns; custom interaction/persistence.

deviations.description: Stock Pagination container with stock Buttons rather than PaginationPrevious/Next/Link. Custom count and page/total display, page sizes 5/10/25/50/100, server page transitions. No numbered-page links or row-selection summary.
deviations.status: Requested server pagination/page size; differs from documentation demo.

deviations.description: Colored tags first, category-specific data columns, round cells, notice/reference fields, link-style item title and untitled ghost-icon actions. Properties uses Pencil only; other categories Eye + notice. No row-selection checkboxes.
deviations.status: Domain requirements; stock Button variants used.

deviations.description: Local label/count sorting and Shift multi-sort; inline editing in a row, save/cancel icons, create route and confirmation delete. No filter, pagination, column selector or active field. Soft deletion retains assignments.
deviations.status: Explicit Tags-grid exceptions.

deviations.description: Defines six hard-coded semantic tag palettes: zinc, blue, emerald, amber, red, purple, each with light/dark styles. TagBadge replaces secondary Badge colors and adds optional shrink/truncation. These colors bypass Neutral theme tokens.
deviations.status: Explicit colored-tags requirement.

deviations.description: Popover + ghost Button + ScrollArea + Toggles containing colored badges. Not a stock shadcn multi-select/Combobox: immediate assignment, no checkmarks, remains open, no Apply/Assign button, no search or select-all, 256px scroll area and left-aligned toggles.
deviations.status: Popover/Toggle approach explicitly approved.

deviations.description: List picker shows at most two badges and +N, flex-nowrap with clipping and full names in title. Detail picker uses auto height and wrapping. Trigger alignment/width/overflow override default Button sizing/layout.
deviations.status: Explicit list truncation and detail-header tags requirements.

deviations.description: Choice wraps stock Select with an options API; LabeledChoice supplies Field/FieldLabel and w-auto. IconAction composes Tooltip + ghost icon Button. Confirm wraps stock destructive AlertDialog. These are local APIs, not additional stock components.
deviations.status: Normal app composition; no primitive redesign.

deviations.description: Read-only Facts renders dl/dt/dd through Field/FieldTitle, role override, two-column layout and explicit 14px regular foreground values. Null/empty values become em dash. Not a stock read-only details component.
deviations.status: Requested label/value alignment; local presentation.

deviations.description: Local responsive PageHeading uses text-2xl font-medium tracking-tight with text-sm muted description. Screen and card spacing is Tailwind composition, not a stock page template.
deviations.status: App layout choice.

deviations.description: Uses unchanged stock default Tabs (not line variant), but w-full min-w-max stretches the tab list across available content width with horizontal overflow; content space-y-4/5 added. Category-specific tabs, URL notice default and editable/view content are app logic.
deviations.status: Full-width tabs and unified detail requested.

deviations.description: Tags sit below the title on the left, above tabs, with wrapping outside the list. General info, research, rounds/related items, notice, registry, property map and images are composed into Cards.
deviations.status: Explicit item information architecture.

deviations.description: RHF + Zod is connected manually with register/useWatch/setValue, stock Field/Input/Textarea/Select and custom Save/Cancel/reset logic. Amounts are text Inputs with decimal keyboard plus currency Select, not a specialized stock currency component.
deviations.status: Approved form foundation; local domain fields.

deviations.description: Research shows FieldError but does not set Field data-invalid or Input/Textarea aria-invalid for notes/appraisal/market errors. Consequently stock invalid-state colors and invalid semantics are not consistently triggered; tag and filter-name forms wire invalid state.
deviations.status: Potential correction; no code changed during this audit.

deviations.description: Entire AND/OR group/term editor, operator/field controls, save/load dialog, Apply/Cancel semantics and saved-filter panel are app compositions. No inline free-text table filter as in the documentation example. Includes w-48 value inputs, native date Input and decimal text inputs instead of Calendar/Date Picker.
deviations.status: Explicit separate-view filters and saved filters.

deviations.description: Input type=file, browser object URLs/session storage, custom thumbnail grid and stock Dialog image viewer. Ghost thumbnail buttons use h-auto/w-full, images have aspect-video/object-cover and viewer max-h-70vh/object-contain. No stock gallery/lightbox component is installed.
deviations.status: Requested attachment tab; image preview behavior is local.

deviations.description: Original notice uses Tailwind Typography prose/prose-sm, max-w-none, whitespace-pre-wrap and dark:prose-invert instead of ordinary shadcn text styles.
deviations.status: Notice-document presentation choice.

deviations.description: Leaflet/react-leaflet imports its own CSS, controls, markers, popups and optional tiles. A h-96 rounded bordered map is wrapped in stock Alert. Map controls/popups do not inherit shadcn component styling.
deviations.status: Leaflet retained by explicit decision.

deviations.description: Reference-inspired application composition, not an unchanged sidebar-demo block: three/four domain groups default open, nested links with icons, section chevrons, and clicking a group in icon mode expands the whole sidebar. Permissions hide System/Tags.
deviations.status: Requested section structure and subsequent visible reference layout.

deviations.description: Uses stock Sidebar icon mode/Rail/Sheet; custom gavel tile/brand, organization menu in header, demo account/role controls in footer (or Clerk user controls), separate language/appearance toolbar and preview banner. AppNavLink closes mobile drawer after navigation.
deviations.status: Requested branding/sections; reference demo adapted to Auctions.

deviations.description: Base Sidebar buttons host Radix DropdownMenu triggers/content for organization/account; Base tooltip provider coexists with root Radix tooltip provider. This is not the linked all-Base demo dependency composition.
deviations.status: Implementation decision; source-owned stock primitives from two foundations.

deviations.description: App main content is centered and max-w-screen-2xl with p-4/md:p-6/lg:p-8, space-y-6. Header min-h-16/wrapping and preview banner styles are local. Full-width tabs mean full available content width, not literal entire browser width. Sidebar uses default variant, not inset/floating.
deviations.status: App shell layout, not provided automatically by shadcn.

deviations.description: Listing empty state is a Card with custom heading/text/action; other empty states use plain paragraphs. Installed components/ui/empty.tsx is not consumed. Skeleton loading shapes/heights and Alert error/retry layouts are also app compositions.
deviations.status: Could use stock Empty more consistently; no change made.

deviations.description: Overview metrics override stock CardTitle to text-3xl; Cards use domain layouts (md:grid-cols-2/3), icon descriptions, flex card actions. Plans, saved-filter alerts, settings, invitation/auth and extraction screens are app content/compositions, not stock blocks.
deviations.status: Custom screens; standard Card/Field/Button variants underneath.

deviations.description: Settings/invite/system use native form validation + local state; system interval uses native number Input (15–1440). Team role Select lives inside DataTable. Not every form uses RHF/Zod. Local permissions, confirmation and toast behavior are not supplied by shadcn.
deviations.status: App implementation choice.

deviations.description: Sonner richColors is enabled, so semantic toast colors can depart from the neutral palette. Theme provider has a plain-D light/dark hotkey and standard next-themes system mode; the hotkey is inherited from the original generated scaffold, not a later primitive edit.
deviations.status: Stock option plus generated-template behavior; not a custom Sonner source fork.

deviations.description: Clerk SignIn/UserButton uses Clerk shadcn theme + localization; it remains Clerk UI, not local shadcn source. next-intl locale routing/messages, PreviewProvider, fake API/data and permissions/persistence are app infrastructure with no stock shadcn equivalent.
deviations.status: Approved auth/i18n foundation; demo state is app code.

deviations.description: Local app helpers use clsx+tailwind-merge cn from lib/utils; generated primitives use the cn package directly. Both exist rather than one project-wide helper path.
deviations.status: Integration consistency difference; no demonstrated visual regression.

deviations.description: Disables set-state-in-effect for unchanged stock mobile hook. ItemGrid also has a scoped exhaustive-deps exception for stable cell closures. These are lint-policy adaptations, not component appearance changes.
deviations.status: Documented implementation decisions.
